_note: Golden-set harness runtime config. Model/token settings for the judge, plus the deterministic S2/S3/composite recompute constants (ADR-003). Composite weights 0.50/0.35/0.15 are the calibration tunable per CRITIC_MODE_PROMPT.md §Procedure step 7.
_model_note: Judge is chosen by model id (ADR-005): gemini-* → Google (free tier), claude-* → Anthropic. Default is the FREE Gemini Flash for $0 validation. Switch to claude-sonnet-5 / claude-opus-4-8 for the private/trustworthy path, or Gemini PAID tier / a local model for real-resume privacy. thinking/effort/stream below are Anthropic-only (ignored by Gemini).
_no_temperature: Anthropic (Opus 4.8 / Sonnet 5) REJECT non-default temperature/top_p/top_k with a 400. Stability gate is perturbation-based (Rev 2), so temperature is not needed — omitted deliberately.

pricing_per_mtok_usd._note: For the report's cost summary. Gemini FREE tier = 0/0 (current). If you switch to a paid model, set the real rates: Sonnet 5 intro 2/10 (std 3/15), Opus 4.8 5/25, Gemini 2.5 Flash paid ~0.30/2.50. cache write = 1.25x input, cache read = 0.1x input.
